description: Lignes électriques souterraines moyenne tension (HTA) - Anglet/opendata-enedis is a dataset listed in Anglet Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Enedis. Ce jeu de données représente la position des lignes souterraines moyenne tension (HTA) sur l’ensemble du réseau de distribution exploité par Enedis. Le système de projection utilisé est le RGF 93 (EPSG 2154). Ces données sont restituées sous la forme d’un découpage en segments. Coverage: Anglet. The portal files it under Mobilité, Espace Public. Its keywords are lignes, souterrain, moyenne tension, HTA, cartographie, infrastructure. The portal shows 970 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-02-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-anglet-opendatapaysbasque-portal.
